newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks dip at noon on fears of violence.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks dip at noon on fears of violence.

text.p: Pakistan stocks dipped at noon on Tuesday on fears of renewed violence in Karachi after overnight killings of five workers of the ethnic Mohajir National Movement (MQM), dealers said.
Dealers said the latest killings had dampened sentiment. "Only PTCL and Hub Power shares are in demand," a dealer said. "But overall sentiment is weak because of violence in Karachi."
The index fell 2.55 points, or 0.16 percent, to 1,579.97 at noon. Losers led gainers 139 to 37. ICI Pakistan fell 0.25 rupees to 24.55. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
